implementationFindings.finding: validate_catalogue currently accepts only HTTPS publication.evangelizo.ws and UUID sourceSubjectID. All six Catholic.co.il/RKC/Blogger candidates are rejected by this provider-specific contract.
implementationFindings.nextStep: Version the reviewed catalogue or add provider-aware validation for sourceRecordId/source URL/exact source-language passage digest and provenance. Preserve the existing Evangelizo validation rules and curated join guardrails.

implementationFindings.finding: Native descriptionByLanguage/descriptionSourceByLanguage/descriptionCreditByLanguage already provide the required output; the source-catalogue provenance extension can remain importer-only.
implementationFindings.nextStep: Enrich canonical Shared data with exact-language prose only, then synchronize all three native asset copies. Existing saint disclosure, optional reminder and widget readers share the same maps.

implementationFindings.finding: A date alone is insufficient: Vincent is displaced by Sunday in modern calendars on 2026-09-27; Francis is displaced by Sunday/Great Advent on 2026-10-04 except the Franciscan source. The 1962 calendar commemorates Thérèse on October 3 and Vincent on July 19, not the modern labels.
implementationFindings.nextStep: Store explicit calendar/date/exact-observance-title/identity bindings shown per candidate; do not borrow source event ranks or add absent commemorations. Keep 1962 outside this small batch until separately reviewed.

implementationFindings.finding: The current 25-word source-excerpt maximum is a repository editorial guardrail; it is not a general license grant or a universal copyright exception.
implementationFindings.nextStep: Record per-provider distribution basis and attribution. First-party factual summaries are a distinct textKind with their own author/license provenance, never passed off as original provider prose; do not invent or machine-translate liturgical Hebrew.

implementationFindings.finding: Authoring independent factual summaries is possible for languages with selected confirmed facts, but the source summary and prose languages must remain explicit.
implementationFindings.nextStep: A later first-party prose path should retain supporting primary sources and an editorial author, with human source-language review. Hebrew remains relayed source wording unless an explicitly authored, qualified editorial text is supplied.
